items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover and arbitrary code execution. Exploitation attempts for CVE-2026-71362 have been detected in the wild.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote attackers to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges. Indications have emerged that threat actors are attempting to exploit this vulnerability in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, denial-of-service, privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, and arbitrary file system read.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source addressing critical and important vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Adobe Commerce B2B)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: This incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary Code Execution via Webhooks
items.summary: A critical, unauthenticated, zero-interaction flaw in the webhooks component can lead to arbitrary code execution. This vulnerability received a CVSS score of 10.0.

items.title: Malicious File Planting on Server
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability allows an attacker to plant malicious files on the server. It was patched as part of the APSB26-73 security update.

items.title: Privilege Escalation / Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity vulnerability enabling privilege escalation or security feature bypass was addressed in the APSB26-73 update.

items.title: Privilege Escalation / Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability allows for privilege escalation or security feature bypass. It was resolved with the release of APSB26-73.

items.title: Privilege Escalation / Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity vulnerability leading to privilege escalation or security feature bypass was included in the APSB26-73 security bulletin.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution.
